title: Subject pronouns
explanation:
Yo is I. Tú is you, for one person you know. Usted is the polite form for one person. Él and ella are he and she. Nosotros is we. In Spain, vosotros is you for a group you know. Ellos is they, and ellas is they for a group of women.

Much of Latin America uses ustedes, not vosotros, for a group. This lesson practises the Spain form. The verb endings come in the next topics. The sentences here are ones you can reuse.
commonMistake: Using vosotros for one person, or using él for a woman.
